item.title: US announces sweeping new tariffs on China, EU, and other trading partners
item.description: The Trump administration on Wednesday announced a new round of tariffs targeting 14 major trading partners, including China, the European Union, Japan, India, South Korea, and Vietnam, following an eight-month investigation into alleged unfair trade practices. item.title: Ukraine says its laser system downs Russian jet-powered drone in world first
item.description: Ukraine announced on November 25 that its Blysk laser system had intercepted a Russian jet-powered Geran drone in combat for the first time, marking a milestone for experimental air-defense technology. item.title: MLB sues players' union, asks court to declare lockout legal
item.description: Major League Baseball on Wednesday filed a lawsuit against the MLB Players Association, asking a federal court to declare that a planned lockout is legal. The league's legal action comes less than a week before the current collective bargaining agreement expires on Dec. 1, with a lockout expected…
